added_lines: happy 100th birthday! world mission sunday is the holy father’s annual appeal for spiritual and financial support so that the life-giving work of overseas mission and missionaries can continue. it takes place this weekend 17th / 18th october. the theme for this year is “one in christ, united in mission”. world mission sunday collections take place in every single parish where the church is present. we ask your generous support. speaking up : being attentive to the wellbeing and safety of children and young people is an important part of safeguarding. if you have a concern about the safety or welfare of a child or vulnerable person, please ensure that you know who to speak to and how to report your concern. our parish safeguarding representatives can provide information and guidance on safeguarding procedures. safeguarding month mission sunday scariff and moynoe

pope leo reminds us that mission is always a work of love —an overflow of the joy we find in god. mission starts in the quiet moments of our daily lives. it is found in: the way we listen to a neighbour who is lonely. the patience we show within our own families the generosity we offer to those struggling in our communities the prayers we lift up for the global church. today, as parishes across ireland and the world unite, we are reminded that we belong to a single, global family. we are "one in christ, united in mission." let us pray for the grace to have our hearts set on fire by the gospel, so that our feet may be ready to move in service, kindness, and love for one another. a very sincere thanks to all the members of pastoral council who joined with us in scariff on wednesday last as we reflected on the story of our inis cealtra pastoral area guided by fr. michael collins. family bingo in ogonnelloe community hall on sundays in november (8th, 15th, 22nd, 29th) from 6-8pm. €10 for one player €30 for family pack. all are welcome parents meeting for sacraments: tuesday 20th october at 7.30 pm in scariff school harvest thanksgiving mass – sunday 25th october at 11 a.m. blessing of graves : old moynoe & new moynoe – sunday 1st november after 11 a.m. mass blessing of kyles : sunday 8th november - carrowmore 2 p.m. & capparoe 2.45 p.m. mass of remembrance : saturday 21st november at 6.30 p.m. annual mass for all who died during the past year. if anyone would like to have a family member or relatives included who died away from the parish in the past year, please leave name into
